summary: Claim FALSE as shipped: production wiring (external-routes-wiring.ts getProjectById) strips the standalone flag so the actions routes still write into the repo (D1, high). Medium: tasks without a resolvable projectId write pastes/.gitignore into the repo (D2); guard/resolver keyed by projectId not path (D3); campaigns readiness GET can run git fetch (D4). Low: over-block of campaign dismiss/restore (D5); meta-test cannot catch narrowed project views (D6).
